extension_discovery: Users find extensions via VS Code Marketplace search (ranked by installs, ratings, recency), GitHub trending, and blog posts. No paid ads. Organic SEO and community are key.

monetization_options.description: User provides own DeepSeek API key, extension is free. Revenue via donations or pro features (e.g., caching, history).
Extension uses pooled API key, charges $5/month. Requires payment processing (Stripe) and server for key management.

three_deepseek_extensions.name: DeepExplain
three_deepseek_extensions.description: Inline code explanation: select code, get plain English explanation via DeepSeek. Fills gap where Copilot only suggests code.
three_deepseek_extensions.implementation: VS Code extension with text selection listener, calls DeepSeek API with prompt 'Explain this code: {code}'. Returns hover or side panel.
three_deepseek_extensions.monetization: Freemium: 10 free explanations/day, then $3/month or user's own API key.

three_deepseek_extensions.name: ArchGen
three_deepseek_extensions.description: Architecture diagram generator: from codebase, generate PlantUML or Mermaid diagrams. Fills gap where Copilot has no diagramming.
three_deepseek_extensions.implementation: Scans workspace files, sends summary to DeepSeek with prompt 'Generate architecture diagram in Mermaid format for this project'. Outputs .mmd file.
three_deepseek_extensions.monetization: Freemium: 5 diagrams/month free, then $5/month or user's own API key.

three_deepseek_extensions.name: TestCovAI
three_deepseek_extensions.description: Test coverage analyzer: identifies untested code paths and generates test cases. Fills gap where Copilot doesn't analyze coverage.
three_deepseek_extensions.implementation: Uses Istanbul for coverage, sends uncovered lines to DeepSeek with prompt 'Generate Jest test cases for these uncovered lines'. Creates test file.
three_deepseek_extensions.monetization: Freemium: 10 test generations/month free, then $7/month or user's own API key.

recommendation: Start with DeepExplain (lowest complexity, fastest to market). Use freemium with user API key to avoid server costs. Scale to managed subscription after 10k users.
